findings.title: Guarded transmission
findings.claim: The focus triad can be read as a custody chain: the Messenger carries a trust, believers maintain its enacted form through prayer, and the wali relation names responsibility for keeping that trust in place.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers wali, Messenger, and ongoing prayer maintenance meet the supplied pericope's distinct images of words displaced from their positions, guarding and witnessing the Book, and oversight. Their contact turns affiliation into successive custodial work while the ordinary protective relation remains recoverable.
findings.reader_payoff: The Messenger and believers become legible as linked bearers and keepers of a trust, so the practice clauses describe how the affiliation is maintained rather than merely who is listed.
findings.containment: This is an attributed contextual reading of responsibility and transmission. It does not replace wali as protective support, make prayer only a metaphor, or extend the evidence into a legal theory beyond the supplied pericope.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and context anchors are supplied and every nominated branch lands in the trace, but contextual branch records and source identity remain unresolved; the reading is therefore retained as attributed evidence.

findings.title: Allegiance economy

findings.mechanism: The focus carriers wali, giving, and zakat meet supplied context forms for consuming corrupt gain, converting signs into sale value, measuring that return as small, and receiving unbought bounty. The opposed material directions make the quality of affiliation visible through where value flows.
findings.reader_payoff: Zakat becomes an embodied audit of affiliation: support moves outward through giving, while exploitative affiliation draws trust inward for consumption or sale.
findings.containment: The economic relation is an attributed pericope-level resonance. It preserves zakat as the ordinary institutional giving and does not reduce the legal material to one economic metaphor.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and contextual anchors and all nine trace branches are supplied, but the contextual branch registry is unresolved and the HFT source is legacy_unbound; the economic relation remains qualified.

findings.mechanism: The focus supplies standing prayer, bowing, and wali relation; the immediately preceding portrait supplies love, gentleness toward believers, strength toward rejecters, and strenuous action. The contact changes bowing from general meekness into a disciplined posture across different relations.

findings.containment: The attributed polarity qualifies the ordinary ritual and humble sense of bowing. It does not make the closing participle a replacement for the ritual state or extend 5:54 beyond the supplied relation.
